Control.name: TemperCombat_RowTemplate
Control.OnMouseUp: TemperCombat.AddSelection( self, button, upInside, ctrl, alt, shift )

Control.name: TemperCombat_UnitRowTemplate
Control.OnMouseUp:
if button == MOUSE_BUTTON_INDEX_RIGHT then TemperCombat.UnitContextMenu( self, upInside ) else
TemperCombat.AddSelection( self, button, upInside, ctrl, alt, shift )
end

Control.name: TemperCombat_BuffRowTemplate

TemperCombat.AddSelection( self, button, upInside, ctrl, alt, shift )
end
